neighbours.label: the first token inside an opening parenthesis when it starts a list label or a name, most strongly enumerators like (a), (b), (1)
fire: Applicants must provide (a) a passport, (b) two photographs and (c) a signed form.
The fund supports projects in (a) housing, (b) transport and (c) public health.
The board shall consist of (a) the mayor, (b) two councillors and (c) one resident.
The term has two senses: (1) a formal promise and (2) a written guarantee.
Students are graded on (a) attendance, (b) homework and (c) the final exam.
The treaty covers (a) fishing rights, (b) shipping lanes and (c) border patrols.
Each kit contains (a) a compass, (b) a whistle and (c) a small first-aid pouch.
Members are drawn from (1) industry, (2) academia and (3) the civil service.
quiet: Applicants must provide a passport, two photographs and a signed form at the desk.
The fund supports projects in housing, transport and public health across the city.
The board shall consist of the mayor, two councillors and one resident (normally).
The term has two senses, a formal promise and a written guarantee, in modern usage.
Students are graded on attendance, homework and (mostly) the final exam.
The treaty covers fishing rights, shipping lanes and border patrols in the north.
Each kit contains a compass, a whistle and a small first-aid pouch for emergencies.
Members are drawn from industry, academia and the civil service (in equal numbers).

notes: Probe: (a)/(b)/(c) 0.69, (1)/(2) 0.42, capitalised name starts inside parentheses 0.29-0.31; lowercase adverb parenthetical 0.03, '(see appendix' 0.004; the same lists without parentheses <=0.09. The + pole is not flagged (the - pole is positional). Fire items use enumerators only; quiet items keep the same lists and use lowercase parentheticals or none.
